summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures trended higher today. DCE's most-traded I2609 contract closed at 706 yuan/mt, up 0.93% from the previous trading session.Spot prices at Qingdao Port rose 3-8 yuan/mt from the prior trading day. Traders quoted actively, while steel mills purchased as needed, leaving overall spot trading moderate.
